none: PAS SUSS-26DA33: Roman Denarius of Antoninus Pius
contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ ANTONINVS A[VG] PIVS P P [TR P XXII] ; R/ VOTA SVSCEP D[E- CENN.III] COS III[I]

A Roman silver denarius to Antoninus Pius (138-161 AD). Mint is Rome, dating from 158-159 AD. Rev. VOTA SVSCEP. DE-CENN.III COS.IIII type depicting Antoninus, veiled and standing facing left, sacrificing with a patera over a tripod, no bull. Obverse legend: ANTONINVS A[VG] PIVS P P [TR P XXII]. Reverse legend: VOTA SVSCEP D[E- CENN.III] COS III[I]. RIC III, p61, No. 293a. Reece period
